comparison.normalization: Replace exactly six leading @[implicit_reducible] attributes in the 4.32.0 stdout with @[instance_reducible]; all remaining UTF-8 bytes must then equal the 4.33.0 stdout.

lean_4_32_0_observation.build_basis: Preserved 4.32.0 project and dependency oleans plus preserved later 4.32.0 project oleans; this was not a fresh 4.32.0 source build.

scope_boundary: This is a bounded comparison of six pretty-printed derived declaration skeletons and six successful instance-synthesis queries, not a complete generated-environment comparison.

Lean's pretty printer elides proof subterms with an ellipsis and refers to generated helper proofs without printing their bodies; those proof bodies and helper declarations are not compared by this receipt.
The retained 4.32.0 side reuses preserved compiled oleans and is not a fresh source rebuild, a source-to-olean proof, or reproducible-build evidence.

Equality after one explicit attribute normalization does not prove semantic equivalence of Lean releases, kernel soundness, theorem intent, executable refinement, scientific validity, or numerical behavior.
The attribute change is disclosed rather than conflated with the unchanged source-written declaration inventory.
